reason: The policy permits modifying pending order items only 'to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.' The proposed tool call attempts to remove items by passing an empty new_item_ids array, which does not constitute 'an available new item' as required by policy. Selective removal of items from a pending order—keeping some items while removing others—is not explicitly permitted. The only policy-supported options for a pending order are: (1) cancel the entire order, which would refund all items, or (2) modify items to different variants of the same product. The assistant's use of 'cancel' language may have misled the user about what operation is actually possible. The correct action would be to offer the user the policy-compliant alternative: cancel the entire order.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
Before taking any action that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation.
